name: Ringve Museum
scope: Ringve Music Museum’s main manor house, Hovedbygningen, as seen in September 2009 before the 2015 fire. Includes the long wooden range, projecting garden room, two unequal towers, and attached entrances at either end. The separate stable, Wessel building, arboretum and exhibition interiors are outside this model.

originalReview.notes: Garden front shows the broad projecting room, white painted siding, ochre frame, tall divided windows and grey shingle gables.
Southwest close view shows the taller open lookout with squared hipped cap, timber braces and warm rail panels, side door, stone base, eaves and individual window surrounds.

Yard view shows the manor on the left. Adopted only for the main house’s two-storey yard elevation, repeated windows, west gable, door and sightline to the lookout cap. The separate right and central buildings are excluded.

review.method: Three exact published Qualla originals with first-party public-domain releases
review.notes: Qualla was checked first. Two exact Daderot originals show the 2009 garden elevations and open lookout, and the exact Mahlum yard view corroborates the same main range before the fire. All three are photographer-released public domain. Separate stable, garden and exhibit images were excluded.
